how.label: How it works
slides: Orders arrive in Telegram
You hear about every new order in your categories right away.
One tap to respond
Respond and the client sees you — a chat opens with them.
Agree and get to work
In Tezkor you agree the price with the client directly; in Tender the contract goes through PRB.

first.label: First response
slides: Tezkor — first come
The agent who takes a Tezkor order first does the job. You can hold several at once.
Tender — competition
Send a price list: the client compares offers and picks the best one.

balance.label: Top up balance
slides: Responses are paid
You are charged only when you send a response. If it is declined, the money returns to your balance.
Top up in advance
With an empty balance you cannot respond — top up in the Balance tab.

profile.label: Complete profile
slides: Logo and portfolio
A complete profile builds client trust and lifts you in the list.
More categories
The more services you pick, the more orders you receive.

rating.label: Rating
slides: Reviews shape your rating
Only the client of a completed order can review, and every review is moderated.

payout.label: When you get paid
slides: Advance in Tender
An advance when work starts, the rest after the client accepts it — minus commission, to your bank account.

tezkor.title: What is Tezkor?
tezkor.p1: For small, urgent tasks. You work directly with the agency that takes your request first.
tezkor.p2: You agree the price and payment with the agency yourself. Not a fit? Release the agent and reopen the request to others.

tender.title: What is Tender?
tender.p1: For bigger projects: several agencies send price lists, you compare and pick the best.
tender.p2: A three-party contract is signed and payment is protected by PRB. Tender is for legal entities — a manager grants access.

how.title: How does PRB work?
how.p1: PRB is where clients find advertising agencies. You describe the task, we send it to matching verified agencies.
how.p2: Agencies respond. You compare ratings and reviews, chat, and choose the one you like.

city.title: What services are available?
city.p1: From billboards and LED screens to SMM, print and design — every advertising service in one app.
city.p2: See nearby agencies and ad spots on the map, or type a service into search.

price.sub: Name your price or wait for agencies to make offers
price.title: How is the price set?
price.p1: In Tezkor you agree the price and payment with the agency directly.
price.p2: In Tender agencies send price lists and you choose. Payment goes to PRB and reaches the agency once you accept the work.

reviews.title: Where do reviews come from?
reviews.p1: Only the client of a completed order can leave a review — no fake ratings.
reviews.p2: Every review is moderated, and an agency's rating is calculated from them.

free.title: Do I pay for anything?
free.p1: You pay only for the finished work. PRB is free for clients.
free.p2: Agencies pay: a fee for each response, and in Tender the platform commission comes out of the agency's share.
